source.title: 1. Choose the quiz
source.help: Upload a quiz JSON file, or paste quiz JSON (for example, a model's answer). Nothing is saved until you choose Save.

report.title: 2. Report
report.canSave: No errors: the quiz can be saved.
report.blocked_one: {{count}} error must be fixed before saving.
report.blocked_other: {{count}} errors must be fixed before saving.
report.question: Question {{id}}

editor.title: 3. Fix and save
editor.label: Quiz JSON
editor.help: Edit the JSON below ({{lines}} lines), then run the preview again.
editor.dirty: You changed the JSON. Run the preview again before saving.
editor.fixFirst: Fix the errors above in the JSON, then run the preview again.

questions.none: No questions could be read yet.

announce.previewOk: Preview finished: {{questions}} questions, {{fixes}} automatic fixes, {{warnings}} warnings. The quiz can be saved.
announce.previewBlocked: Preview finished: {{errors}} errors. Fix them before saving.

issues.duplicate_question_id: Question id {{id}} is used more than once.
issues.answer_not_in_options: The correct answer “{{answer}}” is not one of the options.
issues.correct_answers_not_in_options: The correct answer “{{answer}}” is not one of the options.
issues.duplicate_options: The option “{{option}}” appears more than once.
issues.true_false_options: A true/false question's options must be exactly True and False.
issues.chapters_mismatch: The chapters list must be just chapter {{chapter}}.
issues.single_choice_one_answer: A single-choice question has exactly one correct answer.
issues.multi_choice_needs_answer: A multiple-choice question needs at least one correct answer, starting with the correct answer.
issues.numeric_not_a_number: The answer “{{answer}}” of a numeric question is not a number.
issues.total_questions_mismatch: total_questions says {{stated}}, but there are {{actual}} questions. The counted number is used.
issues.score_mismatch: The score says {{stated}}, but the answers give {{actual}}. The recomputed score is used.
issues.percentage_mismatch: The percentage says {{stated}}, but the answers give {{actual}}. The recomputed percentage is used.
issues.schema_invalid_type: This field has the wrong type (expected {{expected}}).
issues.schema_too_small: Too few items or too short (at least {{minimum}}).
issues.schema_too_big: Too many items or too long (at most {{maximum}}).
issues.schema_invalid_value: This value isn't allowed (expected one of {{expected}}).
issues.parse_failed: No quiz JSON could be found in the text.

fixes.extracted_json: Took the JSON out of the surrounding text or code fence.
fixes.tolerant_parse: Read JSON with small syntax errors (trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys or comments).
fixes.smart_quotes: Replaced curly quotes around JSON strings.
fixes.truncated: The output was cut off: kept the complete questions and dropped the partial last one.
fixes.wrapped_array: Wrapped a bare list of questions in a quiz.
fixes.number_coerced: Read “{{field}}” as a number or text, as the format expects.
fixes.option_to_string: Turned a number option into text.
fixes.option_prefix_stripped: Removed letter prefixes such as “A)” from the options.
fixes.answer_letter_resolved: Answer “{{from}}” was a letter: it is now the option “{{to}}”.
fixes.answer_index_resolved: Answer {{from}} was an option number: it is now the option “{{to}}”.
fixes.answer_prefix_resolved: Answer “{{from}}” had a letter prefix: it is now the option “{{to}}”.
fixes.answer_snapped: Answer “{{from}}” differed only in case or spacing: it is now the option “{{to}}”.
fixes.ids_renumbered: Question ids were missing or repeated: renumbered 1 to {{count}}.
